279901130.description:
Educational Science Collection
Mineral Specimen Set & Polished Decorative Stones
Natural Earth Minerals & Polished Stones, 22 Pieces Total
This mixed geological lot features an educational mineral specimen display alongside a collection of polished decorative stones. The primary display includes eight naturally occurring minerals mounted with their corresponding names and geographic origins within the United States, providing a diverse look at common North American ores and crystals. Accompanying the set are fourteen uniform polished stones featuring a deep green hue with dark linear banding, ideal for decorative use, craft projects, or basic geological study.
Mineral specimens: Fluorite (IL), Pyrite (AZ), Chrysocolla (AZ), Copper (MI), Lepidolite (CA), Galena (MO), Rhodonite (CO), and Quartz (AR)
14 polished oval-shaped stones with green and dark-banded patterns
Display case includes educational text regarding the definition and formation of minerals
Total count: 22 individual pieces (8 specimens in box, 14 loose stones)
Condition:
Very good condition. The eight minerals remain securely attached to the identification card within the plastic display case. The plastic case shows light surface scuffing but no cracks or structural damage. The 14 loose polished stones are smooth with no visible chips, cracks, or deep scratches. All text on the identification card remains crisp and legible.
Thank you for all of your support!

279919144.description:
Title:
Geode Piece Brazil Crystal Mineral Specimen Decorator Collectible
Condition:
Used
Condition Description:
Good, some natural surface wear
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Country Of Origin:
Brazil
Description:
This striking geode piece from Brazil brings the natural elegance of crystal formations right to your space. One side has been smoothly sliced and polished to display a brilliant array of sparkling quartz-like crystals radiating from the center, while the rugged back and natural edges retain the original rocky matrix and earth-toned hues. The transition from the light interior to the deep, banded dark edge adds depth and visual intrigue. Perfect as a decorator piece, its versatile half-round shape allows for easy upright display on desks, shelves, or mantels. The polished interior surface maximizes its visual impact by catching and refracting light, creating a subtle shimmer from multiple angles, while the unrefined back reinforces the raw beauty of natural minerals. This geode decor item is a wonderful addition to mineral collections, office environments, or as a distinctive accent in home decor. Condition is good, with expected variations and surface characteristics from the natural stone and past handling.
